title: Slice 626975: [Expense Agent] Alternate approvers - Delegated/Substitutes (November '26)
summary: Expense Agent adds alternate approvers (delegates and substitutes) for expense approvals. A new Expense Alternate Approver table, page and API are added, approval management is extended, and a new report lets approval requests be delegated.
key_points: New Expense Alternate Approver table and page to set up delegates or substitutes
Expense Report Approval Mgmt extended to handle alternate approvers
New API page for alternate approvers and extra fields on the Expense Reports API
New report to delegate expense approval requests
Expense User pages, setup pages and permission sets updated for the new objects
